statement: For alternative minimum tax purposes, § 421 does not apply to the transfer of stock acquired by exercising an incentive stock option (26 U.S.C. § 56(b)(3)): the exercise-date spread is included in alternative minimum taxable income under § 83 timing, the AMT adjusted basis of the stock reflects that inclusion, and § 422(c)(2) applies only where the disposition and the AMT inclusion fall in the same taxable year.
caveat: The § 83 timing underneath means substantially nonvested stock (e.g. an early exercise without an 83(b) election) defers the AMT inclusion to vesting. A same-year disqualifying disposition can eliminate the adjustment. The minimum tax credit (§ 53) for AMT paid on ISO exercises is real but out of scope here. Whether AMT is actually owed depends on the full return — only an illustration is possible from isolated inputs.
